description: Checks whether a business's website states the same name, address, phone and hours as its Google profile, and whether it has LocalBusiness schema, a click-to-call link and an embedded map. Use it for NAP consistency or to check a location page. With business, the extension reads the profile from Maps and checks the website it links unless url is given. Without the extension, pass url and profile (name, and phone and address if known) and the page is fetched from this computer instead, without running its JavaScript. Returns website (url; name, address, phone and hours each with status match, mismatch, not_found (the site does not state it) or profile_missing (nothing to compare), the profile value and what the site states; localSchema with types and missing fields, or null when the page has no LocalBusiness schema; telLinks; embeddedMap), findings (checks L30 to L35), profileFrom (maps or arguments) and notes. Each finding has checkId (a Local SEO check id such as L7), group, status (pass, partial, fail or not_applicable), severity (high, medium or low on a fail or partial, null otherwise), a one-sentence summary and evidence (url, value, note). not_applicable means the check could not be judged, never that it passed or failed.

mapsUrl.description: A Google Maps link to the place, such as https://maps.app.goo.gl/... .

placeId.description: A Google place id, such as "ChIJ...".

cid.description: A Google customer id (CID), decimal digits, as in maps.google.com/?cid=.

city.description: The town or city it is in, such as "Leeds, UK".

name.description: The business name as Google shows it.

business.description: The business whose profile the site is checked against: {mapsUrl}, {placeId}, {cid} or {name, city}. Needs the extension. Give business, or profile with url.

profile.description: The profile facts to compare, when you have them already. Overrides what the extension reads. With url, this works without the extension. A field left out is not compared.

address.description: The profile address on one line, such as "250 W Nyack Rd, West Nyack, NY".

name.description: The business name as the profile shows it.

phone.description: The profile phone in any format, such as "+1 845-555-0100".

url.description: The page to check, an absolute http or https URL, usually the location page. Defaults to the website the profile links. Required when business is not given.

name: check_website_nap
title: Check website NAP
